shortDescription: Automatic time tracking for your PC. Missing Hours records what you work on and shows your day as a timeline. Everything stays on your computer.
description:
Missing Hours automatically records which programs and windows you use and when you are away from your computer. It turns this into a clear timeline for every day, so you can review your working hours and write invoices without starting a stopwatch.

• Runs in the background and starts with Windows
• Detects breaks and absence automatically
• Daily timeline with your programs' icons
• Light and dark theme
• Privacy first: no cloud, no account, no telemetry. Your data never leaves your computer.

timeline.headline: Where did your hours go?
timeline.subline: Missing Hours records your workday automatically – app by app, no stopwatch.
